title: Runtime status
description: Check whether the Runtime is available and whether its managed execution environment can be controlled.

reasons.runtimeRemovalInProgress: The Runtime is being permanently removed. Runtime access and controls will remain unavailable until removal finishes.
reasons.runtimeFailed: The Runtime could not reach the requested state. Use an available recovery action or try again.
reasons.providerFailed: The managed execution environment reported a failure. Restart it if that action is available.
reasons.runtimeRecreationRequired: The selected settings differ from the currently applied settings. Restart the Runtime to apply them.
reasons.providerDisabled: The selected execution environment is unavailable. Choose another Runtime Profile.
reasons.providerWorkspaceUnavailable: This Workspace cannot currently use the selected execution environment.
reasons.providerDisconnected: Host controls are temporarily unavailable. The Runtime can still be used while its connection remains active.
reasons.providerCapabilityUnavailable: The selected execution environment does not support all required settings.
reasons.providerCapabilityInvalid: The execution environment reported settings that cannot be used.
reasons.profileDocumentInvalid: The selected Runtime Profile contains invalid settings.
reasons.profileIncompatible: The selected Runtime Profile cannot be used with this execution environment.
reasons.runtimeConfigurationBlocked: The selected Runtime settings cannot currently be applied. Review the Runtime Profile.
reasons.runtimeProfileRequired: Choose an available Runtime Profile before starting the Runtime.
reasons.runtimeResetting: The Runtime is being reset. Agent Workspace files are being deleted.
reasons.runtimeRecovering: The execution environment is recovering. The Runtime connection will return when recovery finishes.
reasons.runtimeStarting: The Runtime is starting. It will become available after the connection is established.
reasons.runtimeStopping: The Runtime is stopping. Agent Workspace files are preserved.
reasons.runnerDisconnected: The execution environment is running, but the Runtime connection is unavailable. Restart it if that action is available.
reasons.runnerStarting: The execution environment is running while the Runtime connection starts.
reasons.runnerDegraded: The Runtime connection is limited. Some operations may be unavailable.
reasons.runnerFailed: The Runtime connection failed. Restart the Runtime if that action is available.
reasons.unknown: The Runtime is temporarily unavailable. Refresh the status or use an available recovery action.
